mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_user_id FROM workspaces WHERE id=#{workspace} FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.id,u.username,u.enabled AS account_enabled,wm.enabled,wm.role,wm.revision FROM workspace_memberships wm JOIN app_users u ON u.id=wm.user_id WHERE wm.workspace_id=#{workspace} AND wm.user_id=#{user} FOR UPDATE OF wm,u
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_memberships SET enabled=#{enabled},revision=revision+1 WHERE workspace_id=#{workspace} AND user_id=#{user} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_memberships WHERE workspace_id=#{workspace} AND user_id=#{user} AND revision=#{revision}
